card.name: Closing bracket after section cross-references
card.fires_on: The closing parenthesis or last item right before a closing square bracket, mainly in label cross-references like [see Warnings and Precautions (5.1)]. Also fires on OK inside [ OK ] status lines in server logs.

modes.label: Section reference end
modes.description: The closing parenthesis after a section number inside a [see ...] cross-reference in a drug label.

modes.label: Status text in brackets
modes.description: The word OK inside a bracketed status message in a command-line log.
modes.example: Shutting down http: [ OK ] Starting httpd: [<< OK>> ] Finally, we must test the new

card.writes: It lowers the odds of a closing square bracket or parenthesis coming next, and slightly raises math-style symbols.
card.plain: It fires at the end of a bracketed note, like a section citation, right where the bracket is about to close.
